prompt:
Security report: `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/export?format=zip` downloads whatever URL a cut's `image_path` holds. Set it with `PUT /api/v1/cuts/{id}` to an address inside our network and the ZIP contains that server's response.
Fix it everywhere the backend loads an image from a URL a user can set, not only the export: the backend must never request such an address. Images in our storage and data: URLs keep working. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Exports now skip cuts silently. Say which: when an export leaves out cuts (no image yet, an address it refuses, or an image that cannot be loaded), the ZIP gets a `missing.txt` with their cut numbers, one per line, and both export formats send the header `X-Missing-Cuts` with the numbers separated by commas. With nothing missing there is no `missing.txt` and no header.
Add tests.
In the editor, after an export that left out cuts, tell the user which cut numbers are missing. Both languages.

report.answer: Added localized English and Korean notifications in the editor displaying the missing cut numbers from `X-Missing-Cuts` whenever an episode export skips cuts.

check.why: no user-set URL is requested, stored images work, skipped cuts reported and shown in the editor, tests and changelog

@@ -0,0 +1,451 @@
+"""
+Safe image loading utility for Toonify backend.
+
+Allows loading images from:
+- Inline `data:` image URLs
+- Application object storage (relative storage keys, STORAGE_HOST URLs,
+  configured MinIO/GCS bucket URLs, and `/assets/` paths)
+- Globally routable public HTTP(S) URLs, pinned to the validated IP address
+  with redirect re-validation to prevent SSRF and DNS rebinding.
+
+Never requests loopback, private, link-local, cloud metadata, CGNAT, NAT64,
+reserved, or internal network addresses.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import http.client
+import io
+import ipaddress
+import socket
+import ssl
+import urllib.parse
+from typing import Optional
+
+from PIL import Image
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+from app.services import storage as storage_module
+from app.services.storage import StorageService
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 20 * 1024 * 1024  # 20 MiB
+MAX_REDIRECTS = 3
+
+_BLOCKED_HOSTS = frozenset(
+    {
+        "localhost",
+        "metadata",
+        "metadata.google.internal",
+        "instance-data",
+    }
+)
+_BLOCKED_SUFFIXES = (
+    ".localhost",
+    ".local",
+    ".internal",
+    ".invalid",
+    ".lan",
+    ".home.arpa",
+    ".localdomain",
+    ".intranet",
+    ".corp",
+    ".home",
+)
+_NAT64_NETWORKS = (
+    ipaddress.ip_network("64:ff9b::/96"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("64:ff9b:1::/48"),
+)
+_CGNAT_NETWORK = ipaddress.ip_network("100.64.0.0/10")
+_BENCHMARK_NETWORK = ipaddress.ip_network("198.18.0.0/15")
+
+
+class UnsafeImageUrlError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when an image URL or path targets a disallowed address or scheme."""
+
+
+def _has_control_chars(value: str) -> bool:
+    return any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in value)
+
+
+def _validate_storage_key(key: str) -> str:
+    if not key or _has_control_chars(key) or "\\" in key:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid storage key")
+
+    if ".." in key.split("/"):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Path traversal in storage key")
+
+    unquoted = urllib.parse.unquote(key)
+    if (
+        not unquoted
+        or _has_control_chars(unquoted)
+        or "\\" in unquoted
+        or unquoted.startswith("/")
+        or unquoted.endswith("/")
+    ):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid storage key")
+
+    segments = unquoted.split("/")
+    if any(seg in ("", ".", "..") for seg in segments):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Path traversal in storage key")
+
+    return unquoted
+
+
+def _storage_base_candidates() -> list[str]:
+    candidates: list[str] = []
+    if settings.STORAGE_HOST:
+        candidates.append(settings.STORAGE_HOST.rstrip("/"))
+    if settings.MINIO_ENDPOINT and settings.MINIO_BUCKET:
+        ep = settings.MINIO_ENDPOINT.rstrip("/")
+        candidates.append(f"http://{ep}/{settings.MINIO_BUCKET}")
+        candidates.append(f"https://{ep}/{settings.MINIO_BUCKET}")
+    if settings.MINIO_BUCKET:
+        candidates.append(f"https://storage.googleapis.com/{settings.MINIO_BUCKET}")
+        candidates.append(f"http://storage.googleapis.com/{settings.MINIO_BUCKET}")
+        candidates.append(f"https://{settings.MINIO_BUCKET}.storage.googleapis.com")
+    return candidates
+
+
+def _extract_storage_key(raw: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """
+    If `raw` refers to an object in our storage, return its validated relative key.
+    If `raw` is an HTTP(S) or other-scheme URL not matching our storage, return None.
+    Raises UnsafeImageUrlError on malformed paths or traversal attempts.
+    """
+    if _has_control_chars(raw) or "\\" in raw:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid characters in image URL")
+
+    url_parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(raw)
+
+    # Check `/assets/<key>` frontend proxy path
+    if raw.startswith("/assets/") and not raw.startswith("//"):
+        if url_parts.scheme or url_parts.netloc:
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid asset path")
+        return _validate_storage_key(url_parts.path[len("/assets/"):])
+
+    # Check configured storage base URLs / prefixes
+    for base in _storage_base_candidates():
+        if base.startswith("/") and not base.startswith("//"):
+            if not url_parts.scheme and not url_parts.netloc:
+                prefix = f"{base}/"
+                if url_parts.path.startswith(prefix):
+                    return _validate_storage_key(url_parts.path[len(prefix):])
+            continue
+
+        base_parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(base)
+        if (
+            base_parts.scheme
+            and base_parts.netloc
+            and url_parts.scheme.lower() == base_parts.scheme.lower()
+            and url_parts.netloc.lower() == base_parts.netloc.lower()
+            and url_parts.username is None
+            and url_parts.password is None
+            and "@" not in url_parts.netloc
+        ):
+            if ".." in url_parts.path.split("/") or ".." in urllib.parse.unquote(url_parts.path).split("/"):
+                raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Path traversal in storage URL")
+            base_path = base_parts.path.rstrip("/")
+            prefix = f"{base_path}/" if base_path else "/"
+            if url_parts.path.startswith(prefix):
+                return _validate_storage_key(url_parts.path[len(prefix):])
+
+    # Leading `/` (including scheme-relative `//host/...` or `/etc/passwd`) is disallowed
+    if raw.startswith("/"):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Disallowed image path")
+
+    # Plain relative storage key (no scheme, no authority)
+    if not url_parts.scheme and not url_parts.netloc:
+        first_segment = raw.split("/", 1)[0]
+        if ":" in first_segment or "@" in first_segment:
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Disallowed host format in image path")
+        if url_parts.query or url_parts.fragment:
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Unexpected query or fragment in storage key")
+        return _validate_storage_key(raw)
+
+    return None
+
+
+def _decode_data_url(raw: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    if "," not in raw[5:]:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Malformed data URL")
+
+    meta, payload = raw[5:].split(",", 1)
+    params = [p.strip() for p in meta.split(";")]
+    media_type = params[0].lower() if params else ""
+    if media_type and not media_type.startswith("image/"):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Disallowed data URL media type: {media_type}")
+
+    is_base64 = any(p.lower() == "base64" for p in params[1:])
+    if is_base64:
+        data = base64.b64decode(urllib.parse.unquote(payload))
+    else:
+        data = urllib.parse.unquote_to_bytes(payload)
+
+    if len(data) > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Data URL exceeds maximum allowed size")
+    return data
+
+
+def _is_public_ip(ip: ipaddress.IPv4Address | ipaddress.IPv6Address) -> bool:
+    if isinstance(ip, ipaddress.IPv6Address):
+        if ip.ipv4_mapped is not None:
+            return _is_public_ip(ip.ipv4_mapped)
+        if ip.sixtofour is not None:
+            return _is_public_ip(ip.sixtofour)
+        if ip.teredo is not None:
+            server_ip, client_ip = ip.teredo
+            return _is_public_ip(server_ip) and _is_public_ip(client_ip)
+        if any(ip in net for net in _NAT64_NETWORKS):
+            return False
+    else:
+        if ip in _CGNAT_NETWORK or ip in _BENCHMARK_NETWORK:
+            return False
+
+    return (
+        ip.is_global
+        and not ip.is_private
+        and not ip.is_loopback
+        and not ip.is_link_local
+        and not ip.is_multicast
+        and not ip.is_reserved
+        and not ip.is_unspecified
+    )
+
+
+def _validate_http_url_syntax(url: str) -> tuple[urllib.parse.SplitResult, str, int, Optional[ipaddress.IPv4Address | ipaddress.IPv6Address]]:
+    if _has_control_chars(url) or "\\" in url:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid characters in URL")
+
+    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
+    scheme = parsed.scheme.lower()
+    if scheme not in ("http", "https"):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Disallowed URL scheme: {scheme or 'empty'}")
+
+    if not parsed.netloc or not parsed.hostname:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Missing URL hostname")
+
+    if parsed.username is not None or parsed.password is not None or "@" in parsed.netloc:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Credentials in URL are not allowed")
+
+    try:
+        port = parsed.port or (443 if scheme == "https" else 80)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid URL port") from exc
+
+    if port < 1 or port > 65535:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid URL port")
+
+    raw_hostname = parsed.hostname
+    if "%" in raw_hostname:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("IPv6 zone IDs are not allowed")
+
+    host = raw_hostname.rstrip(".").lower()
+    if not host:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Empty URL hostname")
+
+    if host in _BLOCKED_HOSTS or host.endswith(_BLOCKED_SUFFIXES):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Disallowed hostname: {raw_hostname}")
+
+    labels = host.split(".")
+    if all(lbl.isdigit() or lbl.startswith("0x") for lbl in labels):
+        if len(labels) != 4 or any(
+            not lbl.isdigit() or (len(lbl) > 1 and lbl.startswith("0"))
+            for lbl in labels
+        ):
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Disallowed IP literal encoding: {raw_hostname}")
+
+    try:
+        ip_obj = ipaddress.ip_address(host)
+    except ValueError:
+        ip_obj = None
+
+    if ip_obj is not None:
+        if not _is_public_ip(ip_obj):
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Disallowed IP address: {host}")
+    elif "." not in host:
+        # Single-label hostnames (e.g., internal container/service names) are never public internet hosts
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Disallowed internal hostname: {raw_hostname}")
+
+    return parsed, host, port, ip_obj
+
+
+def _resolve_and_validate_public_url(url: str) -> tuple[urllib.parse.SplitResult, str, int]:
+    parsed, host, port, ip_obj = _validate_http_url_syntax(url)
+    if ip_obj is not None:
+        return parsed, str(ip_obj), port
+
+    addr_infos = socket.getaddrinfo(host, port, type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+    if not addr_infos:
+        raise OSError(f"Could not resolve hostname: {host}")
+
+    pinned_ip: Optional[str] = None
+    for _, _, _, _, sockaddr in addr_infos:
+        ip_str = sockaddr[0]
+        if "%" in ip_str:
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError("IPv6 zone ID in resolved address")
+        resolved_ip = ipaddress.ip_address(ip_str)
+        if not _is_public_ip(resolved_ip):
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Hostname {host} resolves to disallowed IP {resolved_ip}")
+        if pinned_ip is None:
+            pinned_ip = str(resolved_ip)
+
+    assert pinned_ip is not None
+    return parsed, pinned_ip, port
+
+
+def validate_image_url(url_or_path: str) -> None:
+    """
+    Validate an image URL or storage path without downloading it.
+    Raises UnsafeImageUrlError if the URL/path is disallowed or resolves to a non-public IP.
+    """
+    if not url_or_path or not isinstance(url_or_path, str) or not url_or_path.strip():
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Empty image URL")
+
+    raw = url_or_path.strip()
+    if raw[:5].lower() == "data:":
+        _decode_data_url(raw)
+        return
+
+    storage_key = _extract_storage_key(raw)
+    if storage_key is not None:
+        return
+
+    parsed, host, port, ip_obj = _validate_http_url_syntax(raw)
+    if ip_obj is None:
+        try:
+            addr_infos = socket.getaddrinfo(host, port, type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+        except socket.gaierror:
+            # Offline/unresolvable public domain is not an internal-network target;
+            # actual fetch will re-resolve and pin before opening any socket.
+            return
+        for _, _, _, _, sockaddr in addr_infos:
+            ip_str = sockaddr[0]
+            if "%" in ip_str or not _is_public_ip(ipaddress.ip_address(ip_str)):
+                raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Hostname {host} resolves to disallowed IP {ip_str}")
+
+
+def _fetch_public_http_bytes(url: str, timeout: float = 10.0) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    current_url = url
+    for _ in range(MAX_REDIRECTS + 1):
+        parsed, pinned_ip, port = _resolve_and_validate_public_url(current_url)
+        scheme = parsed.scheme.lower()
+        hostname = parsed.hostname
+        assert hostname is not None
+
+        target = parsed.path or "/"
+        if parsed.query:
+            target = f"{target}?{parsed.query}"
+
+        default_port = 443 if scheme == "https" else 80
+        host_header = f"[{hostname}]" if ":" in hostname else hostname
+        if port != default_port:
+            host_header = f"{host_header}:{port}"
+
+        conn: Optional[http.client.HTTPConnection] = None
+        try:
+            sock = socket.create_connection((pinned_ip, port), timeout=timeout)
+            if scheme == "https":
+                ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
+                sock = ctx.wrap_socket(sock, server_hostname=hostname)
+                conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection(hostname, port=port, timeout=timeout, context=ctx)
+            else:
+                conn = http.client.HTTPConnection(hostname, port=port, timeout=timeout)
+            conn.sock = sock
+            conn.request(
+                "GET",
+                target,
+                headers={
+                    "Host": host_header,
+                    "User-Agent": "Toonify/1.0",
+                    "Accept": "image/*,*/*;q=0.8",
+                    "Connection": "close",
+                },
+            )
+            resp = conn.getresponse()
+            if resp.status in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308):
+                location = resp.getheader("Location")
+                if not location:
+                    return None
+                current_url = urllib.parse.urljoin(current_url, location)
+                continue
+            if resp.status != 200:
+                return None
+            data = resp.read(MAX_IMAGE_BYTES + 1)
+            if len(data) > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES:
+                return None
+            return data
+        finally:
+            if conn is not None:
+                conn.close()
+
+    return None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(
+    url_or_path: Optional[str],
+    *,
+    raise_on_unsafe: bool = False,
+    timeout: float = 10.0,
+    storage_service: Optional[StorageService] = None,
+) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """
+    Safely load image bytes from a `data:` URL, our storage, or a validated public HTTP(S) URL.
+    """
+    if not url_or_path or not isinstance(url_or_path, str):
+        return None
+    raw = url_or_path.strip()
+    if not raw:
+        return None
+
+    try:
+        if raw[:5].lower() == "data:":
+            return _decode_data_url(raw)
+
+        storage_key = _extract_storage_key(raw)
+        if storage_key is not None:
+            svc = storage_service or storage_module.storage
+            return svc.download_image(storage_key)
+
+        return _fetch_public_http_bytes(raw, timeout=timeout)
+    except UnsafeImageUrlError as exc:
+        logger.warning("Blocked unsafe image URL", url=raw[:120], reason=str(exc))
+        if raise_on_unsafe:
+            raise
+        return None
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Failed to load image", url=raw[:120], error=str(exc))
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_pil(
+    url_or_path: Optional[str],
+    *,
+    mode: Optional[str] = None,
+    raise_on_unsafe: bool = False,
+    timeout: float = 10.0,
+    storage_service: Optional[StorageService] = None,
+) -> Optional[Image.Image]:
+    """
+    Safely load an image as a PIL Image.
+    """
+    img_bytes = load_image_bytes(
+        url_or_path,
+        raise_on_unsafe=raise_on_unsafe,
+        timeout=timeout,
+        storage_service=storage_service,
+    )
+    if not img_bytes:
+        return None
+
+    try:
+        img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes))
+        img.load()
+        if mode:
+            img = img.convert(mode)
+        return img
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Failed to decode image bytes", error=str(exc))
+        return None

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+
+
+def _setup_episode(client, headers):
+    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    ep = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Episode Two", "project_id": proj["id"], "episode_order": 1},
+    ).json()
+    return proj, ep
+
+
+def _add_cut(client, headers, episode_id, cut_order, image_path=None):
+    payload = {
+        "episode_id": episode_id,
+        "cut_order": cut_order,
+        "script": f"Cut {cut_order}",
+    }
+    if image_path is not None:
+        payload["image_path"] = image_path
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=headers, json=payload)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def test_exports_omit_missing_txt_and_header_when_no_cuts_are_missing(client):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, ep = _setup_episode(client, h)
+
+    key = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="cut-1")
+    data_url = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode("ascii")
+
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep["id"], 1, image_path=key)
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep["id"], 2, image_path=data_url)
+
+    r_zip = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert r_zip.status_code == 200, r_zip.text
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" not in {k.lower() for k in r_zip.headers.keys()}
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r_zip.content)) as zf:
+        assert sorted(zf.namelist()) == ["Episode_Two_01.png", "Episode_Two_02.png"]
+        assert "missing.txt" not in zf.namelist()
+
+    r_strip = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert r_strip.status_code == 200, r_strip.text
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" not in {k.lower() for k in r_strip.headers.keys()}
+    assert r_strip.content.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n")
+
+
+def test_exports_report_all_skipped_cut_reasons_in_missing_txt_and_header(client):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    h = signup(client, email="missing@example.com")
+    _, ep = _setup_episode(client, h)
+
+    valid_key = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="valid-1")
+    corrupt_key = storage.upload_image(b"not-a-valid-png", schema="cuts", identifier="corrupt-5")
+    valid_data_url = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode("ascii")
+
+    # Cut 1: valid storage image
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep["id"], 1, image_path=valid_key)
+    # Cut 2: no image yet
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep["id"], 2, image_path=None)
+    # Cut 3: refused internal address
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep["id"], 3, image_path="http://127.0.0.1:9999/secret.png")
+    # Cut 4: missing object in storage (cannot be loaded)
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep["id"], 4, image_path="cuts/missing/does-not-exist.png")
+    # Cut 5: unreadable/corrupt image bytes (cannot be loaded)
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep["id"], 5, image_path=corrupt_key)
+    # Cut 8: non-contiguous valid cut
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep["id"], 8, image_path=valid_data_url)
+    # Cut 10: malformed data URL (cannot be loaded)
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep["id"], 10, image_path="data:image/png;base64,bm90LWFuLWltYWdl")
+
+    expected_missing = ["2", "3", "4", "5", "10"]
+
+    r_zip = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert r_zip.status_code == 200, r_zip.text
+    assert r_zip.headers.get("X-Missing-Cuts") == ",".join(expected_missing)
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r_zip.content)) as zf:
+        assert sorted(zf.namelist()) == ["Episode_Two_01.png", "Episode_Two_08.png", "missing.txt"]
+        assert zf.read("Episode_Two_01.png") == PNG
+        assert zf.read("Episode_Two_08.png") == PNG
+        missing_txt = zf.read("missing.txt").decode("utf-8")
+        assert missing_txt == "2\n3\n4\n5\n10\n"
+        assert missing_txt.splitlines() == expected_missing
+
+    r_strip = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert r_strip.status_code == 200, r_strip.text
+    assert r_strip.headers.get("X-Missing-Cuts") == ",".join(expected_missing)
+    assert r_strip.headers["content-type"] == "image/png"
+    assert r_strip.content.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n")
+
+
+def test_cors_exposes_x_missing_cuts_header(client):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    h = signup(client, email="cors@example.com")
+    _, ep = _setup_episode(client, h)
+
+    key = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="cors-1")
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep["id"], 1, image_path=key)
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep["id"], 2, image_path=None)
+
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/export?format=zip",
+        headers={**h, "Origin": "http://localhost:3000"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.headers.get("X-Missing-Cuts") == "2"
+    exposed = r.headers.get("access-control-expose-headers", "")
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" in exposed

+import base64
+import http.server
+import io
+import socket
+import threading
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def internal_server():
+    """Starts a local HTTP server inside the network and records every request."""
+    hits: list[str] = []
+    secret_body = b"INTERNAL-SECRET-SERVER-RESPONSE"
+
+    class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+        def do_GET(self):
+            hits.append(self.path)
+            payload = PNG if self.path.endswith(".png") else secret_body
+            content_type = "image/png" if self.path.endswith(".png") else "text/plain"
+            self.send_response(200)
+            self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
+            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
+            self.end_headers()
+            self.wfile.write(payload)
+
+        def log_message(self, format, *args):
+            pass
+
+    server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
+    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+    thread.start()
+    port = server.server_address[1]
+    try:
+        yield {"port": port, "url": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}", "hits": hits, "secret": secret_body}
+    finally:
+        server.shutdown()
+        server.server_close()
+
+
+def _create_project_episode_cut(client, headers, *, style_reference_url=None):
+    proj_payload = {"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}
+    if style_reference_url is not None:
+        proj_payload["style_reference_url"] = style_reference_url
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json=proj_payload)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    proj = r.json()
+
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Episode One", "project_id": proj["id"], "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    ep = r.json()
+
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"episode_id": ep["id"], "cut_order": 1, "script": "Opening shot"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cut = r.json()
+    return proj, ep, cut
+
+
+def test_zip_export_never_requests_internal_network_urls(client, internal_server):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, ep, cut = _create_project_episode_cut(client, h)
+    port = internal_server["port"]
+
+    blocked_urls = [
+        f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/secret",
+        f"http://localhost:{port}/secret",
+        f"http://[::1]:{port}/secret",
+        f"http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]:{port}/secret",
+        f"http://0.0.0.0:{port}/secret",
+        f"http://2130706433:{port}/secret",
+        f"http://0x7f000001:{port}/secret",
+        f"http://0177.0.0.1:{port}/secret",
+        f"http://127.1:{port}/secret",
+        "http://10.0.0.1/secret",
+        "http://172.16.0.1/secret",
+        "http://192.168.1.1/secret",
+        "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+        "http://100.64.0.1/secret",
+        "http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/",
+        "http://internal-service:8080/secret",
+        "file:///etc/passwd",
+        f"//127.0.0.1:{port}/secret",
+    ]
+
+    for target_url in blocked_urls:
+        r_put = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut['id']}", headers=h, json={"image_path": target_url})
